reason: Fails the earnable payout and atomicity checks. FeeDistributor.claim(_user,_tokens) can be called by a stranger, but the official Infusion FeeDistributor source transfers to claimReceiver[_user] or _user, never msg.sender. A fresh wallet's own claim returns zero; invoking an LP's claim pays that LP. depositFees() allocates pair fees to locked LPs and has no caller bounty. Earning requires an LP position locked across days, outside the one-transaction profit guarantee and not a holding-frame asset sellable at any time. The observed pot was only $5.40 in one self-claim across 11 distributors in 7 days. No bot.
